title_sq: Super vile luksoze per shitje prane TEG!
description_sq:
Ne nje nga rezidencat me te qeta dhe te preferuara ne zonen e TEG, ofrohet per shitje nje vile individuale e organizuar ne 4 kate. Ambjentet e perbashketa te gjelberuara me shije dhe me kujdes.
Vilat individuale ka nje siperfaqe ndertimi prej 360 m2 banim e gjitha e shfrytezuar me se miri nga pronaret aktual pasi ambjentet e brendeshme dhe te jashteme i kane organizuar duke maksimizuar hapesiren ne cdo kate te saj, siperfaqe parcele 425m2, dhe 3 poste parkimi.
Vila eshte me kater kate nga te cilit nje kat eshte nen toke por qe ka drite natyrale pasi eshte me dritare, ky kate eshte i organizuar ne 2 dhoma, nje tualet, studio, garderobe, depo.
Kati perdhe eshte i konceptuar i gjithi si ambjent gatimi, ngrenie dhe ndenie, tualet dhe nje verande ne oborrin e kuruar te viles.
Ne katin e pare qendron dhoma em gjumit e cifitit me 2 garderoba dhe dy tualete ndersa ne katin e dyte jane dy dhoma gjumi secila me tualet personal.
Genti
title_en: Super luxury villa for sale near TEG!
description_en: In one of the quietest and most popular residences in the TEG area, an individual villa organized in 4 floors is offered for sale. Common areas greened with taste and care. The individual villas have a construction area of ​​360 m2 of living space, all of which are best used by the current owners, since the internal and external environments have been organized by maximizing the space on each of its floors, a plot area of ​​425 m2, and 3 parking spaces. The villa has four floors, of which one floor is underground but has natural light as it has windows, this floor is organized in 2 rooms, a toilet, studio, wardrobe, storage room. The ground floor is designed as a cooking, dining and living area, a toilet and a veranda in the well-kept yard of the villa. On the first floor is the master's bedroom with 2 wardrobes and two toilets, while on the second floor there are two bedrooms each with a personal toilet. Gent
